Thanks again for the interest in a Private (air-gapped) deployment. We'd like to schedule a focused architecture deep-dive to review VPC boundaries, on‑prem connectivity patterns, storage/S3-equivalents, key management, and the offline update workflow.

Proposed agenda (attached):
- Intro & goals (10m)
- Network & ingress/egress requirements (20m)
- Storage, backups, and secrets (15m)
- Upgrade and air-gap image delivery process (15m)
- Compliance / audit evidence & questions (15m)
- Next steps / owners (10m)

We can run a 60–90 minute session depending on how deep you want to go. To make scheduling easier, can you confirm which of these windows work on your side (all PT):
- Wed Feb 22: 11:00–12:30 PT
- Thu Feb 23: 08:00–09:30 PT
- Fri Feb 24: 13:00–14:30 PT

I've attached the baseline agenda and a short pre-call checklist that helps us prioritize items. If you have an internal compliance lead you want to include, please CC them and we'll add a short compliance readout.

Thanks,
Jonas
